environment.description: Same service deployed on-premises with a Thales Luna Network HSM 7 (firmware 7.8.2+) connected via PED-authenticated partition. The HSM partition is configured with a per-slot operation throttle policy (SO-configured via lunacm 'partition setThrottle') limiting C_Sign calls to 5 operations per client session per rolling 10-second window, returning CKR_DEVICE_BUSY (0x00000030) for excess calls. The application treats any non-success PKCS#11 return code as a signing failure and returns HTTP 503. Additionally, the HSM partition's 'Maximum Sessions Per Application' is set to 1, forcing all sign operations through a single serialized session handle.

config.hsm: Thales Luna Network HSM 7, firmware 7.8.2, PED-auth partition
config.load_balancer: F5 BIG-IP with iRule limiting concurrent connections per client to 2
config.network: HSM on dedicated FIPS-140-2 L3 network segment, no sidecar
